name: Project: Wish
detailed_description:
Project: Wish is currently a working title, as it is in the early stages of development. Aspects of the game are subject to change over time as we continue to refine the design and scope of the game.

A Cute Tower Defense... with a Twist!

Project: Wish is a tower defense base builder where you are the last remaining pelican fighting against the shadow that enveloped the world. To do so you must rescue fellow animals, befriend them with dice rolling and use their powers to defend lighthouses from shadow enemies, upgrade towers and bring back the light!

Befriend

Fly around to discover animal creatures in need of help, bring them into your community and befriend them to gain access to their animal towers! Use Star Dice in order to roll for friendship checks and improve your relationship one animal at a time.

Build

Use the towers gifted by your community to find the perfect layout of defenses before the shadows come to test your strength. Master tower placement to receive buffs, and upgrade towers once your bond has strengthened with your community!

Defend

Collect stardust to turn into Star Dice and manage your towers while the shadows test your resolve. Can you expand the lighthouse's light and survive another night?

Features:

  • Multiple maps with 3+ levels each

  • Over a dozen towers with single upgrade paths

  • Tower Synergies - certain towers will give each other buffs or have unique qualities when placed next to each other

  • Wave Based Gameplay

  • Dice Interactions - Use dice rolling to interact with animals and improve your relationships

  • Cute and vibrant visuals

short_description: A tower defense game about building community. After the world is enveloped in darkness you must fend off shadows, upgrade your defenses and build your relationships with a cast of animal NPCs. Can you survive the waves of darkness and return the light to your community?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 1600x or Intel 7500k
  • Graphics: GTX 970
  • Sound Card: any
